definitions.material_buy_clip: an already admitted pending buy has authorized_shares / requested_shares < 0.50
definitions.near_capacity: gross_before >= 0.95 * gross_cap, or the already-admitted buy authorization ratio is below 0.50
definitions.nearby_incumbent_trim: an ordinary account_budget_trim was planned on the same close or one of the previous five replay sessions and actually filled no later than five replay sessions after the clipped intent
definitions.higher_effective_capacity: on the clipped close incumbent authorization exceeds limited protection by at least 0.25, or incumbent buys at least one additional board lot of the same symbol and strategy during the next twenty replay sessions
definitions.pre_divergence_identity: cash, gross, held books and pending economic intents are equal on the final common budget close before the first incumbent ordinary trim
definitions.linked_positive_gap_share: share of positive daily increases in incumbent-minus-limited equity gap occurring while incumbent has more close-known exposure to symbols in qualifying clipped-buy chains
definitions.capacity_chain_major_source: a qualifying capacity chain exists, the pre-divergence state is identical, the first trade divergence is not earlier than the first incumbent ordinary trim, and linked_positive_gap_share >= 0.35
definitions.gap_formed_by_2024_share: positive incumbent-minus-limited asset gap at the final 2024 session divided by the positive terminal asset gap
definitions.non_trend_positive_gap_growth_share: share of positive daily increases in incumbent-minus-limited asset gap occurring when the existing production route is not TREND

requirements: at least two of pool_b, pool_d, pool_g fail in the common window
failed pools contain real already-admitted buys clipped below 50 percent
those buys occur while capacity is near or binding
incumbent ordinary trims were planned and actually filled near the blocked opportunities
incumbent subsequently had materially higher effective capacity
capacity chains are a major source in at least two of pool_b, pool_d, pool_g
no data, account, fee, causality or execution correctness failure
at least two of pool_b, pool_d, pool_g have common-window wealth ratio >= 0.90
at least two of pool_b, pool_d, pool_g form at least 70 percent of the terminal gap by the end of 2024
at least two of pool_b, pool_d, pool_g form at least 70 percent of positive gap growth in an existing non-TREND route
no new regime indicator or threshold is needed

stop.when: neither path A nor path B satisfies every frozen requirement
stop.effect: do not implement an economic candidate; preserve evidence; close the PR; leave main unchanged

prohibitions: no pool, symbol or date exceptions
no candidate implementation before the selected path is frozen
